# sea_g2p

Dart bindings for [sea-g2p](https://github.com/pnnbao97/sea-g2p) (Apache-2.0),
which normalizes Vietnamese text and converts it to phonemes.

Prebuilt libraries in `prebuilt/` come from tag `v0.10.0`
(commit `dae5ca83ea45f356c43bdb70a1bcd42e8729ff16`), built with
`scripts/build.sh`. The `sea_g2p.bin` dictionary is not bundled; the app
downloads it.
